title: Specimen book
description: Four botanical engravings fill a clothbound volume with paired page faces, a shaded gutter and layered paper edges.
useCase: Preview a small printed collection while preserving page order, image fidelity and the relationship between both faces of a leaf.
interaction: Turn the spreads, go back or close the cover.

assets.description: Lillium Pomponium (Turban Lily), plate 7 from Les Liliacées

reducedMotion: Page and cover transforms settle immediately for reduced motion and keyboard actions. Host pause disables page controls and settles the current turn.
limitations: Two rigid turning leaves and a fixed final plate; not flexible paper simulation or a document renderer. The original interface uses separately licensed CC0 museum imagery.
look: Pale sage-grey backdrop with an open dark-green clothbound book showing two hand-coloured botanical engravings on cream paper, round translucent arrow buttons beneath.
motion: Arrow buttons swing a rigid leaf 180° around the spine in 3D over 640 ms ease-out; opening or closing also slides the book 83 px; keyboard turns are instant.
adapt: Each `sb-leaf` turns by an inline `rotateY` with a 640 ms CSS transition; `turn` updates `leaf` and lifts the turning leaf's `zIndex` via `moving`. Replace `plates` and the cover artwork; keep `data-calm`, which disables transitions for reduced motion and keyboard.
